suppress.notes:
CVE-2026-119586 is a command injection in the sqlite3 command-line shell: its .recover command copies dot-commands planted in sqlite_schema.sql into its output verbatim, and they run when that output is piped back into the shell. NVD records it against cpe:2.3:a:sqlite:sqlite up to and including 3.54.1, which is the CPE dependency-check derives for sqlite-jdbc as well.
sqlite-jdbc does not carry the shell. Its native library is built from the SQLite amalgamation (sqlite3.c) and JNI glue; the shell (shell.c) and the recover extension the shell drives are not part of it, and nothing in the backend runs a sqlite3 binary or emits .recover output. Checked in the 3.54.1.0 artifacts: neither the Linux nor the Windows x86_64 native library contains the string "sqlite3_recover" or ".recover".
The library bugs in the same NVD batch (CVE-2026-119371 to CVE-2026-119379, CVE-2026-119591) are not suppressed, including the ones in extensions the driver is not compiled with: the sqlite-jdbc 3.54.1.0 override in backend/pom.xml carries the fixed library, which clears them all.
